title: 2.6.3 Blood Sugar Regulation
description: Insulin, glucagon, glycogen and the control of blood glucose concentration

questions.question: The main source of energy for the normal functioning of body systems, including the brain, is:

Insulin promotes the conversion of glucose into:
When blood glucose level is low, the pancreas releases more:

The role of insulin in blood glucose regulation is to:
options: lower blood glucose by storing it as glycogen
raise blood glucose by breaking down glycogen

questions.question: The role of glucagon in blood glucose regulation is to:
options: raise blood glucose by breaking down glycogen
lower blood glucose by storing it as glycogen
remove glucose from the body as urine
convert glucose directly into body fat
questions.correctAnswer: raise blood glucose by breaking down glycogen
